pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify stored customer history before claiming saved details
lesson.when: A customer asks if their previous conversation history or specific question is saved and available in the system
lesson.do: Check verified sources or tool outputs for historical logs before claiming knowledge of the customer's prior question
lesson.otherwise: State clearly that the prior information is not available or verified, without making up or assuming past context
triggers: hỏi về câu hỏi lần trước
